text:
morgan: Quick check before tomorrow's orientation  some folks in APAC say the calendar shows the wrong time. Can someone confirm timezone and join info?

keisha: Looking now. Event was created with UTC. We're running at 10:00 PT (America/Los_Angeles).

morgan: Could we make the event timezone explicit, re-upload the .ics, and paste the ISO start time in the description? That helps clients that ignore TZ changes.

anya: On it. I'll set TZ to America/Los_Angeles, attach a fresh ICS, and add this line to the description: Start (PT): 2027-01-12T10:00:00-08:00.

keisha: Also paste the raw Zoom URL + passcode and a fallback link in the body. Mobile calendar apps sometimes strip query params. Example snippet to include:

Zoom: https://zoom.us/j/5551234567?pwd=onboard
Passcode: RwWelcome2027
Fallback: https://zoom.us/w/5551234567

anya: Done. ICS uploaded, TZ set to America/Los_Angeles, and description updated with ISO start time and Zoom/fallback snippet. I also added a 1-line troubleshooting note for Outlook/Apple Calendar users.

morgan: Great. Where will the recording be posted? A few new hires will watch later.

onboarding-bot: Recording will be uploaded to s3://redwood-onboarding/orientation and a share link posted to #new-hires within 30 minutes after the session. Retention: 90 days.

keisha: Can we pin the recording in the event and post chapter timestamps in this thread after upload? Makes it easier to jump to sections.

anya: Yes, I will pin the recording to the event and post timestamps here once it's available. Also sending a DM to APAC attendees with the PT time to avoid confusion.

morgan: Thanks all. If anyone still sees wrong times after the update, reply here and we'll send one-off invites. :thumbsup:
